Asset type: transparent square 2D RimWorld mushroom plant sprite. ONE isolated tiny mature growth UNIT, never a sprite sheet.
Style: exactly match the supporting RimWorld plant sprite: heavy warm dark-brown clean outlines, only 2-3 flat cel-shaded color planes, small readable silhouette, slightly top-down three-quarter view, no realistic texture, no gradients, no fine engraving.

No soil, grass, log, rocks, root tuft, box, container, shadow on a ground plane, text, labels, watermark or border. Real alpha transparency outside the object, never draw a checkerboard. This is a fully grown plant unit that the game repeats and scales.
Input 1: actual Omphalotus japonicus photograph (also called O. guepiniformis), species shape only. Input 2: existing Oyster sprite, game linework and simplicity only.
Subject: TWO mature overlapping thick asymmetrical semicircular fan-shaped brown mushroom caps, upper larger and lower smaller. The broad caps have a dusky chestnut to muted purplish-brown top, a lighter beige rolling outer lip, and pale cream underside with just 3 simple radiating gill planes. Short stout off-center lateral stalks fuse at a compact root point. A small cupped depression on each broad top, a heavy ear/fan silhouette that differs from gray oyster mushrooms. Normal daylight colors, absolutely NO green glow, no bioluminescence. Natural mature variant A, not a pile or full bush.
